title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Pine Knob Music Theatre, Clarkston | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Pine Knob Music Theatre in Clarkston, Michigan, USA, on 11 June 2000.

It was the 21st show by the sixth All-Starr Band. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr had previously performed at the Pine Knob Music Theatre, also known as the DTE Energy Music Theatre, on 30 July 1989 and 15 June 1992, 10 July 1995, and 30 May 1997. He returned there on 7 August 2003, 16 June 2006, and 27 June 2014.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
